title: Replace architecture-builder admin with operational admin
summary: The plugin admin must become a practical product surface for reusable filter presets and WordPress content models, not a frame-driven architecture builder.
rationale: The current admin UI exposes process language such as frames, inspectors, architecture bands, and deferred contracts. That makes the plugin look more complex without helping the implementer complete real WordPress and Elementor work. The product value is strongest when WordPress backend handles reusable/global structures and Elementor handles placement, preview, and visual styling.
alternatives_considered: Continue implementing CPT and Integrations frames inside the architecture-builder UI
Remove the admin area entirely and keep every setting inside Elementor
Keep the builder UI as a portfolio-only visual artifact
evidence: User product direction on 2026-05-18: admin is required, but only to complement Elementor and WordPress workflows.
JetSmartFilters uses WordPress dashboard surfaces for reusable filters and settings while builders consume those filters.
Existing plugin runtime value lives in Filter Controller, DOM listing detection, AJAX filtering, FilterPresets, and CptManager.
risks: Legacy architecture-builder classes may remain temporarily unused until a dedicated cleanup pass removes proven dead code.
Operational forms must preserve nonce, capability, sanitization, and escaping guarantees because they mutate WordPress options and CPT definitions.
